mapper.select: SELECT 'APPROVAL' AS targetType, A.POS_TRX AS targetTrxNo, A.ATTEMPT_SEQ AS targetAttemptSeq, A.POS_TRX AS originalPosTrx, A.ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, CASE WHEN A.FINAL_STATUS = 'UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT' THEN A.UPDATED_AT ELSE A.CREATED_AT END AS candidateSince FROM PAYMENT_ATTEMPT A WHERE (A.FINAL_STATUS = 'UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT' AND A.UPDATED_AT <= #{unknownTimeoutBefore}) OR (A.FINAL_STATUS IS NULL AND A.CREATED_AT <= #{staleProcessingBefore}) ORDER BY candidateSince, A.POS_TRX, A.ATTEMPT_SEQ

SELECT 'CANCEL' AS targetType, C.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS targetTrxNo, NULL AS targetAttemptSeq, C.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, C.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, CASE WHEN C.CANCEL_STATUS = 'UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT' THEN C.UPDATED_AT ELSE C.CREATED_AT END AS candidateSince FROM PAYMENT_CANCEL C WHERE (C.CANCEL_STATUS = 'UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT' AND C.UPDATED_AT <= #{unknownTimeoutBefore}) OR (C.CANCEL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND C.CREATED_AT <= #{stalePendingBefore}) ORDER BY candidateSince, C.CURRENT_TRX_NO

SELECT 'REVERSAL' AS targetType, R.CURRENT_TRX_NO AS targetTrxNo, NULL AS targetAttemptSeq, R.ORIGINAL_TRX_NO AS originalPosTrx, R.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ AS originalAttemptSeq, R.CREATED_AT AS candidateSince FROM PAYMENT_REVERSAL R WHERE R.REVERSAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND R.CREATED_AT <= #{stalePendingBefore} ORDER BY candidateSince, R.CURRENT_TRX_NO
